content: Idiomatic multi-host flake directory layout, strong consensus across EmergentMind/nix-config, zenware/nixos-config, moons-14/dotfiles, cinque.dk bomba, ruiiiijiiiiang/nixos-config, hyprnixmacs, cig0: flake.nix (entrypoint + inputs) -> lib/ (mkHost/mkSystem helpers, host registry) -> hosts/<hostname>/{default.nix,configuration.nix,hardware.nix,home.nix,secrets.yaml} -> modules/ (reusable system modules; often split modules/nixos + modules/home; optional feature-bundle layer via custom mkEnableOption options.my.*) -> home/ (shared HM modules imported by every host) -> overlays/ + pkgs/ (custom packages), secrets/ or per-host secrets.yaml. Profile/Role layers (hosts += [profiles], profiles/{interfaces,platforms,workloads}) aggregate modules and prevent 30-line import lists in host configs (cinque.dk anti-pattern). EmergentMind hard rule: hosts/common/core must be on all hosts, hosts/common/optional opt-in. Some multi-user repos use users/<username>/ instead of a fixed user. secrets: sops-nix (shared file per host or central secrets/*.yaml w/ path_regex rules) or agenix; EmergentMind keeps an encrypted private git repo as a flake input instead of inline encrypted files.
